content_of_post_to_comment: I truly do not understand the bizarre American sentiment “I’ll be bored if I retire” or “not working leads to cognitive decline.” Really? You’ve mastered Latin and ancient Greek and read the entire classical canon in the original? You have perfect Italian and have read all of Dante, Petrarch, and Boccaccio? You know real and complex analysis and various other branches of higher mathematics forwards and backwards? Literally what is wrong with people?!?
comment: I wonder whether people fear boredom itself or the loss of being needed. Retirement removes the structure and social validation of work, not necessarily the intellectual opportunities.
